title: Verify the Require Review setting drives the review flow when turned on
permissions_required: Admin / owner (settings) + Work Order edit access.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin at https://sv7301.qa.shopview.com.
2. Require Review Before Completion is ON and saved.
steps: 1. Open a work order with approved lines.
2. Start completion.
3. Observe that the review flow is used.
expected: 1. With Require Review ON, completing routes into the review flow rather than completing directly.
notes: Wording+VIU 2026-07-13 (S2-15823 live, Require Review ON): with Require Review ON, completing routes into the review flow (Send To Review), not a direct complete.

title: Verify the completion CTA relabels to 'Complete & Send to Review' when review is on
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Review is ON.
3. A work order with approved lines is ready to complete.

2. Read the wizard's primary CTA label.

FLAG: the wizard's final review CTA wording ('Complete & Send to Review' per prior notes) not cleanly reproduced this run.

title: Verify the Mark Reviewed dialog captures VIN (required) and disables Confirm until VIN is entered

title: Verify Mark Reviewed is gated by the Review Work Orders permission and disabled for a role without it
preconditions: 1. A role with Review Work Orders and a role without it both exist.
2. A work order is in Review state, sent to review by a known user.
steps: 1. Sign in as a role without Review Work Orders and open the work order in Review.
2. Confirm Mark Reviewed is disabled with 'Awaiting review'.
3. Sign in as a role with Review Work Orders (system defaults grant it broadly; it can be limited to manager/foreman via custom roles) and confirm Mark Reviewed is available.
expected: 1. A role without the Review Work Orders permission sees Mark Reviewed disabled with an 'Awaiting review' indicator.
2. A role with the Review Work Orders permission can Mark Reviewed and sign off.

3. A user who holds the Review Work Orders permission may Mark Reviewed a work order they completed themselves — self-review is allowed in v1 with NO reviewer != completer identity restriction (the gate is purely the permission).

notes: Wording+VIU 2026-07-13: Mark Reviewed gated by Review Work Orders (woReviewWorkOrders) per fresh roles matrix (roles-matrix-2026-07-13.md); role without it sees Mark Reviewed disabled + 'Awaiting review'; self-review allowed when the role holds the permission (Milos ruling). title: Verify cores are resolved per rules before sign-off and invoicing is blocked until both Reviewed and all cores resolved
permissions_required: Work Order edit access + Finance access.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. Require Review is ON and a work order has inventory and special-order cores.
steps: 1. Resolve inventory cores in the completion modal (after Pick) before Send to Review.

notes: VIU-Pending (non-seedable): needs a WO with genuine inventory + special-order cores to verify core resolution before sign-off and the invoicing block until Reviewed AND cores resolved. A genuine special-order (vendor-source) core is not seedable in-app (see SF-CORE cluster). Review flow confirmed live.

2. Sign in as a role without App Settings and attempt to open and modify the same page.
3. As the role without App Settings, attempt to save a Work Order settings change directly (API), and note the response.
expected: 1. Only a role with the App Settings permission (system defaults Admin, Service Manager and Office) can view and modify the Work Order settings page.
2. A role without App Settings cannot open or change the Work Order settings.
3. The backend rejects a Work Order settings save attempted by a role that lacks App Settings.
notes: Wording+VIU 2026-07-13: role expectation re-verified against the fresh live roles matrix (roles-matrix-2026-07-13.md; GET /api/roles/{id} + /api/auth/me/fe-permissions, no system-role drift). Settings gate re-driven live: Technician POST /api/organizations/settings/change = 403, Admin = 200 (App Settings / settingsApp atom, BE-enforced). FE redirects non-admin from the settings route.

Complete-WO gate = workOrdersCreateAndEdit; roles that can complete (Admin, Service Manager, Senior SA, Service Advisor, Foreman, Parts Manager) vs cannot (Technician, Parts Tech, Office, Sales Rep, Time Clock) match the matrix. title: Verify permission gating of Simple-Flow settings and work-order actions (UI gating is the v1 pass criterion)
permissions_required: Admin (API access) + a lower role credential.
preconditions: 1. Signed in with API access.
2. A relevant Simple-Flow setting (e.g. Require Vendor Invoice Number) is ON.
steps: 1. As a role that lacks the mapped permission, confirm the gated setting or action is hidden or unavailable in the app.
2. As that same role, try the same setting change directly through the API (bypassing the app) and note the response.
3. As a role that lacks the completion or review sign-off permission, try to complete a work order and to sign off a review directly through the API and note the responses.
4. As a role that only has Work Orders: Create & Edit, try to receive parts onto a work order through the API and note the response.
expected: 1. In the app, a role without the mapped permission does not see or cannot use the gated setting or action (this is the v1 pass criterion).
2. The Work Order settings save is also blocked at the backend: the unauthorized API request is rejected with HTTP 403.

3. Work order completion and review sign-off are NOT blocked at the backend today: a direct API call from a role lacking the permission still succeeds (HTTP 200). This still passes v1 on the app-level restriction, but the backend gap is a known issue to fix later — note it as 'app blocks / backend allows'.
4. Because several work-order permissions share the same backend check, any role with Work Orders: Create & Edit can receive parts onto a work order through the API.
notes: Wording+VIU 2026-07-13: role expectation re-verified against the fresh live roles matrix (roles-matrix-2026-07-13.md; GET /api/roles/{id} + /api/auth/me/fe-permissions, no system-role drift). Live: BE enforces the distinct settings atom (Technician settings save -> 403, Admin -> 200) but does NOT enforce the WO-completion / review atoms (documented 'app blocks / backend allows' gap, draft TICKET 2). v1 pass = app-level restriction (Milos Round-2 ruling). Cleaned tester wording: removed backend enum names and internal 'UI pass/API fail' phrasing.
